hotel_name: Veranda High Resort, MGallery Chiang Mai

claims.text: The resort is part of MGallery by Accor and is set on a hillside in Hang Dong district, Chiang Mai.

findings.quote: is a 5-star luxury mountain resort under MGallery by Accor, set on a hillside in Hang Dong district, Chiang Mai

claims.text: The resort is divided into two zones: one represents the cultural heritage of northern Thailand, the other the contemporary Veranda style.

findings.quote: Divided into two zones, on one side representing the cultural heritage of the north and the other the Contemporary Veranda style.

claims.text: The resort is a compound of timber and concrete structures scattered across a valley of rice paddies, wildflowers and tropical greenery.

findings.quote: This breathtaking compound of timber and concrete structures scattered across a valley dense with rice paddies, wildflowers, and tropical greenery

claims.text: All rooms feature contemporary Lanna design, a bathtub and a private balcony with mountain or garden views.

findings.quote: All rooms feature contemporary Lanna design, a private balcony with mountain or garden views, a bathtub, and a Smart TV.

claims.text: The Luxury Pool Villa has three bedrooms, a private pool, a fully equipped kitchen and a poolside dining area.

findings.quote: Three bedrooms give every generation room to spread out, while the private pool, fully equipped kitchen and poolside dining area make it easy to swim

claims.text: The Presidential Pool Villa has a private pool, a private garden, a terrace with panoramic valley views and dedicated Villa Host service.

findings.quote: a private swimming pool, private garden, multiple bedrooms, a living room, a bathroom with bathtub, a terrace with panoramic valley views, and dedicated Villa Host service

claims.text: Rabiang Cha restaurant is a modern version of a traditional northern rice granary.

findings.quote: The restaurant is modern version of a traditional northern rice granary

claims.text: The Higher Room is the all-day dining restaurant, with outdoor seating looking over the infinity-edged pool and the valley.

findings.quote: All day dining restaurant set high above our private valley
outdoor al fresco with views over the infinity edged pool and the valley beyond

claims.text: The Cultural Pavilion offers Thai cooking, yoga and Muay Thai.

findings.quote: Learn the art of thai cooking, Yoga and Muay Thai.

claims.text: Guests can join a hands-on rice planting experience in the rice field.

findings.quote: Step into the rice field and discover how one of Thailand’s most important crops is grown through a hands-on farming experience.

claims.text: Morning alms giving introduces guests to Thai Buddhist tradition.

findings.quote: Introduce the family to Thai Buddhist tradition through the peaceful experience of morning alms giving.

claims.text: The Kids' Club has educational toys and a daily programme of indoor and outdoor activities, and a separate children's pool sits alongside the infinity pool.

findings.quote: Educational toys and a daily programme of indoor and outdoor activities give younger guests somewhere to play and explore.
Alongside the resort’s mountain-view infinity pool is a separate children’s pool

claims.text: Accommodations are set on a scenic valley slope with views over rice and tea terraces and multiple water features.

findings.quote: are all set on a scenic valley slope with views over rice and tea terraces and multiple water features

claims.text: The infinity pool is on the roof terrace of the main building, overlooking the valley.

findings.quote: Veranda high infinity pool is on the roof terrace of the main building over looking the valley

claims.text: Each spa cottage is a self-contained private spa with a large sunken bath, a steam shower and twin treatment beds suited to couples; treatment products were developed by the resort's own therapist.

findings.quote: Each private cottage is a self contained spa with large sunken bath, Steam shower and twin treatment beds ideal for couples
All products used for treatments have been developed by our own experienced therapist

claims.text: A tunnel of polished concrete cooled by falling water forms the entrance into the resort's inner courtyard.

findings.quote: A tunnel of polished concrete cooled by falling water creates a dramatic entrance into the resort’s inner courtyard

claims.text: Room types with private pools include the Plunge Pool Pavilion, the Pool Villa and the Presidential Pool Villa.

findings.quote: offers several room types with private pools, including the Plunge Pool Pavilion (with a private plunge pool), Pool Villa, and Presidential Pool Villa

claims.text: The resort is outside the city, about a 30-minute drive from downtown Chiang Mai.

findings.quote: Located outside the city of Chiang Mai and away from the hustle and bustle
The resort is about a 30-minute drive from downtown Chiang Mai

claims.text: Doi Suthep Temple is about 50 minutes from the resort.

findings.quote: Doi Suthep Temple (50 min)
